They have two sites in the city and they are opening a third soon.

At some other GP practices in the city, the *only* way to get an appointment is by phoning first thing in the morning and hoping that they still have some slots available. By contrast, at Cornbrook it's usually possible to book routine appointments about 2-4 weeks in advance, and get more urgent appointments much more quickly.

All GPs are struggling at the moment because the NHS is underfunded and overstretched in accordance with the government's austerity policies.
